name: Working Overtime
overview: Scripture teaches that while diligent labor brings profit, excessive toil driven by anxiety or selfish ambition is ultimately futile, as God grants rest to His beloved (Psalms 127:2; Proverbs 14:23; Proverbs 23:4). Believers are encouraged to work wholeheartedly as unto the Lord, relying on Christ’s strength to sustain them (Colossians 3:23; Philippians 4:13). True abundant life is found not in overworking but in Christ who came to give life in its fullness (John 10:10).
